name: The Shooting Star Addition
description: An unofficial addon for The Shooting Star. Adds two skills to the Stellar Remote: SA-01 · Halley and SA-02 · Luna. Halley: a comet called down onto your crosshair. It comes in low over the horizon, ploughs a frozen trench toward your mark and detonates on it, leaving an icy crater with the comet's glowing heart standing in it. Luna: the moon itself falls on your crosshair, blasts out a huge crater and drives deep into it, and stays there, a moon of edible moon cheese with a molten heart. Power, damage and speed sliders like the original's skills. Optional: no cooldowns for every skill on the remote. Works with The Shooting Star (Demo) 1.3.3, 1.3.4, 1.4.0, 1.4.1, 1.4.2 and 1.4.3 on Fabric 1.21.1.
